data.name: Umarayn
data.long_meaning: Umarayn is derived from Umar, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad, and the suffix '-ayn' indicating duality or elevation. It signifies someone who embodies the qualities of Umar or is elevated in status.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Umarayn may symbolize justice, wisdom, and leadership, reflecting the attributes of Umar ibn Al-Khattab, a renowned companion of the Prophet Muhammad.

in_arabic.name: عمرين
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من عمر، يعني الشخص الذي يعيش طويلاً
in_arabic.long_meaning: عمرين هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من اسم عمر، ويعني الشخص الذي يعيش طويلاً أو الذي يتمتع بطول العمر، وقد ورد في بعض الروايات التاريخية أن النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: «من سلم من شر مضرّات أربع قبل أجله، فهو عمر طويل»

in_urdu.name: عمرین
in_urdu.meaning: عمر سے مشتق، یعنی طویل عرصے تک جینے والا شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: عمرین ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، عمر سے مشتق ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو طویل عرصے تک جینے والا ہو یا جس کی عمر لمبی ہو، اسلامی تقویم میں عمر بن خطاب، جو رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کے دوسرے خلیفہ تھے، کا نام بھی عمر ہے

in_hindi.name: उमरन
in_hindi.meaning: उम्र से लिया गया, जिसका अर्थ है लंबे समय तक जीवित रहने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: उमरन एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है लंबे समय तक जीवित रहने वाला या लंबी उम्र वाला, इस्लामी परंपरा में उमर का नाम बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, जो पैगंबर मुहम्मद के दूसरे खलीफा थे

in_pashto.name: عمرين
in_pashto.meaning: د عمر څخه مشتق شوی، معنی یې دى هغه څوک چى ډېر ژوند کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: عمرين د يو مذکر نوم دى چى د عربي ژبى څخه اخستل شوى دى، د عمر څخه مشتق شوی، او مطلب يې دى هغه څوک چى ډېر ژوند کوي يا چا ژوند اوږد وي، د پښتنو په کلتور کې دا نوم ډېر استعمال کېږي

in_english.name: Umarayn
in_english.meaning: Derived from Umar, meaning long-lived individual
in_english.long_meaning: Umarayn is a masculine name derived from the Arabic root 'umr', meaning 'long life' or 'long-lived'. Etymologically linked to Umar, a prominent companion of Prophet Muhammad and the second Caliph of Islam. The name signifies longevity, endurance, and strength. Historically, Umar ibn Al-Khattab was renowned for his justice and leadership. The name Umarayn reflects these positive attributes and connotes a person of great character and spiritual significance in Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: Umarayn has a significant cultural impact within Islamic history as it is the name of two prominent rulers: Umar Ibn Al-Khattab, the second Rightly Guided Caliph of Muslims, and Umar II, the seventh Umayyad Caliph. Their leadership and contributions shaped the political, military, and social landscape of the early Islamic Empire. The name carries the reverence and inheritance of these powerful and inspiring figures.
data.spiritual_significance: Umarayn holds spiritual significance as it alludes to the incredible qualities of the revered character Umar Ibn Al-Khattab. Umar was known for his justice, wisdom, humility, and prolific academic pursuits during his time. As a caliph, he was firm in his religious practices and unwavering in his commitment to spread the teachings of Islam. The name symbolizes the desire to live a life of integrity and dedication in emulation of Umar. Ultimately, Umarayn urges us to be not only spiritually enriched and disciplined, but may remind us to aspire for exalted status and the great impact on others that comes from consistently manifesting noble virtues.

historical_references.context: Umarayn was a prominent military and political leader during the early Islamic conquests. He is considered one of the Rashidun caliphs, who ruled during the first century of Islamic history.
